biggest_catch: Field Agent's official app listing states jobs generally pay $3-$20, but publishes no official per-task active work time.
catches: No official per-task time: third parties report minutes to 30 min, but Field Agent's official materials publish no active work time.
Jobs are first come, first served - no guaranteed availability.
Submissions must pass quality review to be approved; denied submissions are not paid.
Some jobs pay only in prize-draw entries, not cash (per third-party reports).
In-person jobs may require purchases or travel costs.
